before.sourceText: The woman had a fattened calf in the house. She hurried and killed it; and she took flour and kneaded it, and baked unleavened bread of it.
before.reasonJa: 固定WEB本文に照らし、person:saul_2478は直前文脈で一意に指される対象として採用した。集団と地域、同名IDは区別し、明示的な根拠がない背景人物は加えていない。

after.sourceText: The woman had a fattened calf in the house. She hurried and killed it; and she took flour and kneaded it, and baked unleavened bread of it.

changedVerses.basisJa: 固定WEB 1SA28:24の文面を再読。女の調理行為のみでサウルへの明示言及・照応はない。

before.sourceText: Therefore now rise up early in the morning with the servants of your lord who have come with you; and as soon as you are up early in the morning and have light, depart.”

after.sourceText: Therefore now rise up early in the morning with the servants of your lord who have come with you; and as soon as you are up early in the morning and have light, depart.”

changedVerses.basisJa: 固定WEB 1SA29:10の話者・宛先を確認。「your lord」はサウルに限定できない。

after.sourceText: David’s two wives were taken captive, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

changedVerses.basisJa: 固定WEB 1SA30:5の地名由来形容詞を、同一著者方針の1SA27:3に揃えて地名へのdirect言及として扱う。人物と地名の同一性を主張しない。

noteJa: 28:24はSaulを追加せず、旧reasonの誤記だけを除去。29:10のSaulは一意に指せないため除外。30:5の地名由来形容詞は27:3と同じ基準で地名へのdirect言及として扱い、人・場所の同一性は主張しない。
